description: Petroleum Fiscal Intelligence Platform — Static JSON API

countries.description: All country summaries with DCF results at 4 price levels

mechanics.description: Fiscal mechanic summary (Concession, PSC, TSC, PRRT, etc.)

disclaimer: For informational and research purposes only. Not investment advice.
